newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands profit boosts MIM result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands profit boosts MIM result.

text.p: Mining and smelting group MIM Ltd said on Friday a A$146.6 million profit from the sale of its shares in Highlands Gold Ltd helped give MIM an abnormal profit after tax of A$130.9 million for the year to June 30.
MIM earlier reported a net profit after abnormals of A$170.6 million and a net profit before abnormals of A$29.8 million vs A$38 million a year earlier.
* the writeback of provisions of A$22.3 million relating to the NCA coal project,
* a gain of A$38.9 million arising from the restructuring of investments in Europe and the rationalisation of external loans to the Duisburg operation in Germany, offset by,
* a write-off of capitalised exploration of A$30.7 million, * provisions against refining assets of A$4.5 million,
* other provisions of A$6.4 million, and,
* writedowns of metals stocks of A$6.1 million, plant and equipment of A$13.1 million and Hilton deferred expenses of A$16.1 million, after utilising existing provisions of A$17.0 million.
MIM said operating cashflow was A$145 million in 1995/96, compared with A$353.6 million in 1994/95.

"The lower level of operating cash flow was due to inventory restocking at Mount Isa and the Townsville and Northfleet refineries, the build-up of initial inventories at McArthur River, and value added tax paid, but not yet reimbursed at the Alumbrera project in Argentina," MIM said.
MIM shares were up five cents at A$1.64 at 2.10 pm (0410 GMT).
